title: quoya verbascina
intro: Quoya verbascina, commonly known as Verbascum thapsus, is a biennial plant species in the figwort family Scrophulariaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and acting as an antiseptic and antiviral agent. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum thapsus are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. Additionally, the plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis, due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties.
